title: Disk-usage alert cron — BUG Telegram on lancedb > 20 GB

impl_summary.cron_description: Hourly at minute=47 UTC — avoids pile-up with minute=0/7/17 cluster

threshold.note: Default 20 GB MUST NOT be raised in prod. LanceDB currently at ~29 GB — alert WILL fire immediately on first hourly tick post-deploy.

ac_results.AC-4-1: PASS — diskUsageAlertJob registered in cronConfig.ts (key=diskUsageAlert, '47 * * * *') + wired in startScheduler.ts via jobRunRepo.wrapRun. Will appear in cron_job_runs 1h after deploy.
ac_results.AC-4-2: PASS — BUG Telegram fires when usage > threshold. Verified via smoke test: DISK_ALERT_THRESHOLD_GB=1, simulated usage=2GB → result=alert-sent.
ac_results.AC-4-3: PASS — Silent when usage <= threshold. Verified: TC-1 (18GB < 20GB = ok), TC-5 (12 consecutive ticks at 18GB = 0 Telegrams).
ac_results.AC-4-4: PASS — Zero false positives pattern confirmed by TC-5: 12 consecutive under-threshold ticks = 0 BUG messages.

smoke_A_low_threshold.verdict: PASS — alert fired correctly above threshold

smoke_B_high_threshold.verdict: PASS — clean state confirmed below threshold

default_threshold_fire.verdict: PASS — prod alert fires at current lancedb size (29 GB > 20 GB)

cases: TC-2a: over-threshold (25GB) → alert-sent, BUG Telegram fired
TC-2b: BUG message contains threshold and size
TC-3a: second tick within 6h cooldown → suppressed
TC-5: 12 consecutive ticks at 18GB → zero Telegrams (integration)
TC-6: jump from 18GB to 25GB → exactly one Telegram on first over-threshold tick (integration)

regression_note: Full suite crash (Bun 1.3.13 OOM known bug with large suites). Recent sprint tests (1959+1958+1955+1954+1942): 56 pass / 0 fail. No regression detected.
production_note: LanceDB currently at ~29 GB (2026-05-20 incident). Alert WILL fire on first hourly tick (minute=47) post-deploy. This is correct behavior per handoff. Watchdog-4 compaction (gated 2026-05-22T21:00Z) will eventually reduce footprint below 20 GB.
